questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most 5-Wicket Hauls' in the 25/26 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Jessica Candler holds it, with a total of 2, a joint record shared with Aphilile Adonisi.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Dolphins or Knights?
Who holds the record for 'Best Bowling Figures in an Innings' in the 22/23 season (combined T20 + List A)?
At Newlands Stadium, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Leah Jones holds it with 19, a joint record shared with Nosipho Vezi.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2019/20 season?
Who has achieved the 150 runs and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Lanette Pienaar or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Lanette Pienaar: 2 times. Susan Benade: 1 times.
